localized.description:
The World Flag Battle Final. 207 countries entered. These 16 came through:

🇺🇸 🇷🇴 🇱🇰 🇬🇧 🇲🇦 🇪🇸 🇷🇺 🇳🇱 🇧🇩 🇦🇿 🇮🇷 🇸🇩 🇻🇨 🇺🇦 🇦🇷 🇹🇭

Russia was eliminated after 0.9 seconds — the fastest exit of the entire
tournament, in the biggest match of it. The UK went at 4.4. Romania at 5.6.

The champion is 🇧🇩 Bangladesh.

Subscribe — the next tournament starts with a clean draw of all 207.
